headline: Christmas Countdown
tagline: One tiny moment of magic every day

scenes.title: Cotton Ball Santa Beard
tips: Glue one cotton ball a day
scenes.say: Glue on one cotton ball each day and watch Santa's fluffy beard fill up by Christmas.

scenes.title: Gingerbread Kindness Cards
tips: Tuck the cards into a jar
Pull one good deed a day
scenes.say: Cut the cards apart, tuck them in a jar, and pull one kind deed every morning.

scenes.title: Retro Paper Chain
tips: Loop the strips into a chain
Tear off one link each day
scenes.say: Loop the strips into a chain and let the kids tear off one link each night.

scenes.title: Ornament Tree Circles
scenes.say: Color or sticker one circle a day, working up the tree until you reach the star.

scenes.title: Christmas Reading Grid
tips: A quick book prompt each day
Mark the box when it's read
scenes.say: Each square has a quick story prompt, so bedtime reading becomes part of the countdown.

scenes.title: Climb to Christmas Steps
scenes.say: Color one step a day and climb all the way up to the little house at the top.

scenes.title: 12 Days Sticker Boxes
scenes.say: Starting late? Twelve big boxes still give you a full countdown ending on Christmas Day.

tips.title: Before you print
tips.say: Use card stock for glue and stickers, and grab the black and white pages for coloring.

say.title: Free printable Christmas countdowns to make every December day special.
say.hook: December is almost here, so print one tonight and start on the first.
say.end: Download them all free at printamoo dot com.
